title: Efficient Text-to-Image Generation: An Adaptive Step Schedule Controller for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.16572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models often use a fixed number of denoising steps, balancing time costs and image quality. However, the optimal number of steps depends on the complexity of the input text prompt. We propose an adaptive diffusion controller that dynamically adjusts the number of steps to generate high-quality images efficiently, without additional model training. By leveraging a mixture of step schedules with varying step sizes and evaluating the error term discrepancy at each timestep, our method transitions between schedules to optimize performance. Experiments on COCO and DiffusionDB show that our approach reduces inference time while maintaining visual fidelity, offering a more efficient alternative for text-to-image diffusion models.

translated_title: 高效文本到图像生成：一种用于扩散模型的自适应步数调度控制器
translated_abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型通常使用固定的去噪步数，以平衡时间成本和图像质量。然而，最优步数取决于输入文本提示的复杂程度。我们提出了一种自适应扩散控制器，能够动态调整去噪步数，在无需额外模型训练的情况下高效生成高质量图像。通过利用具有不同步长大小的多种步数调度组合，并在每个时间步评估误差项差异，我们的方法在不同调度之间进行切换以优化性能。在COCO和DiffusionDB数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在保持视觉保真度的同时减少了推理时间，为文本到图像扩散模型提供了一种更高效的替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的自适应扩散控制器，可根据文本提示的复杂度动态调整去噪步数，在保持图像质量的同时显著减少推理时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free adaptive diffusion controller that dynamically adjusts the number of denoising steps based on text prompt complexity, reducing inference time while maintaining visual fidelity.
